body.query: query($search:String,$page:Int){Page(page:$page,perPage:30){media(search:$search,type:ANIME,sort:SEARCH_MATCH){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}description(asHtml:false)bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes duration seasonYear averageScore genres isAdult}}}

query($page:Int){Page(page:$page,perPage:30){pageInfo{hasNextPage}media(type:ANIME,sort:TRENDING_DESC){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes seasonYear averageScore isAdult genres}}}

query($page:Int){Page(page:$page,perPage:30){pageInfo{hasNextPage}media(type:ANIME,sort:POPULARITY_DESC){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes seasonYear averageScore isAdult genres}}}

query($page:Int){Page(page:$page,perPage:30){pageInfo{hasNextPage}media(type:ANIME,sort:SCORE_DESC){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes seasonYear averageScore isAdult genres}}}

query($page:Int,$year:Int,$season:MediaSeason,$genres:[String],$formats:[MediaFormat],$status:MediaStatus,$sort:[MediaSort]){Page(page:$page,perPage:50){pageInfo{hasNextPage}media(type:ANIME,isAdult:false,seasonYear:$year,season:$season,genre_in:$genres,format_in:$formats,status:$status,sort:$sort){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes seasonYear averageScore isAdult genres}}}

query($id:Int){Media(id:$id,type:ANIME){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}description(asHtml:false)bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes duration seasonYear averageScore genres isAdult nextAiringEpisode{episode}}}

query($idMal:Int){Media(idMal:$idMal,type:ANIME){id idMal title{english romaji userPreferred}description(asHtml:false)bannerImage coverImage{extraLarge large medium}format status episodes duration seasonYear averageScore genres isAdult nextAiringEpisode{episode}}}
